run_gaussian_cluster_instance: run gaussian_cluster_instance to cluster 3D Gaussian points using KMeans or HDBSCAN with optional DBSCAN denoising
run_assign_noise_nearest_cluster: run assign_noise_nearest_cluster to assign noise points to nearest labeled cluster using FAISS nearest neighbor search
run_bhattacharyya_distance_batch: run bhattacharyya_distance_batch to compute vectorized Bhattacharyya distance between two sets of paired Gaussian distributions
review_gaussian_cluster_instance: review gaussian_cluster_instance to understand how it clusters opaque points and reassigns transparent and noise points
review_assign_noise_nearest_cluster: review assign_noise_nearest_cluster to understand L2 and Bhattacharyya distance thresholding for noise reassignment
